title: EGOHOME 8-Inch Memory Foam Mattress Review: Real Testing Results After 6 Months
metaDescription: Honest review of the EGOHOME 8-inch memory foam mattress after 6 months of use. Testing comfort, support, cooling, and real-world performance.
content:
## Unpacking and Setup

The compressed mattress arrived in a compact box that weighed about 37 pounds - manageable for one person but easier with two. Once you cut the plastic, it expands pretty quickly. I gave it the recommended 24-48 hours to fully decompress, though it was mostly ready after about 12 hours. There's a slight chemical smell initially that dissipates within a few days.

## Sleep Quality and Comfort

The medium-firm feel hits a sweet spot for combination sleepers. I'm primarily a side sleeper but occasionally switch to my back, and this mattress accommodates both positions without creating pressure points. The memory foam layer contours to your body without that sinking feeling you get with some softer mattresses. Hip and shoulder pressure is noticeably reduced compared to my old spring mattress.

The 8-inch height works fine on most bed frames, though it's lower than traditional mattresses. If you're used to a taller bed, you might notice the difference when sitting on the edge.

## Temperature and Cooling

The green tea gel infusion does provide some cooling benefits, though don't expect miracle results if you're a hot sleeper. The mattress sleeps cooler than standard memory foam but warmer than hybrid or innerspring options. Summer nights require good room ventilation, but it's not uncomfortably warm for most people.

The cooling effect is most noticeable during the first few hours of sleep. By morning, the mattress has absorbed body heat, which is typical for memory foam construction.

## Durability and Support

After six months of nightly use, the mattress maintains its shape well. No visible sagging or permanent indentations where we sleep regularly. The base foam provides adequate support for the memory foam layer, preventing that bottoming-out feeling.

Edge support is decent for sitting but not exceptional. The perimeter compresses more than the center, which is normal for all-foam construction. It's fine for sleeping near the edge but won't support sitting on the very edge long-term.

## Motion Isolation

This excels at motion isolation. Partner movement is barely noticeable, even when they get up during the night. The memory foam absorbs movement effectively, making it ideal for couples with different sleep schedules or restless sleepers.

## Value and Build Quality

The CertiPUR-US certification provides peace of mind about foam quality and safety standards. Construction feels solid - no weak spots or inconsistencies in the foam layers. The cover fabric is basic but functional, with good stitching quality.

For a bed-in-a-box option at this thickness, it delivers on the fundamental promise of comfortable memory foam sleep without premium pricing.

## Real-World Performance

Daily use reveals both strengths and limitations. The mattress works well for average-weight sleepers but might feel too soft for heavier individuals who need firmer support. Lighter sleepers find the contouring comfortable without excessive sinkage.

Response time is typical for memory foam - you'll feel the slow bounce-back when changing positions. This isn't ideal if you prefer the quick response of latex or innerspring construction.

## Who Should Consider This

This mattress suits side sleepers and combination sleepers who want pressure relief without breaking the budget. It's particularly good for couples who need motion isolation and anyone transitioning from a firm innerspring to memory foam comfort.

Skip this if you're a dedicated stomach sleeper, run very hot at night, or prefer the bouncy feel of traditional spring mattresses. The 8-inch height also makes it less suitable for adjustable bases or platform beds where you want more height.
pros: Excellent motion isolation prevents partner disturbance during sleep
Green tea gel infusion provides noticeable cooling compared to standard memory foam
Medium-firm feel accommodates side and back sleepers comfortably
Compressed shipping makes delivery and setup manageable
CertiPUR-US certification ensures foam safety and quality standards
Effective pressure point relief for hips and shoulders
Maintains shape well after months of regular use without sagging
cons: Edge support is weak for sitting or sleeping near the perimeter
8-inch height is lower than standard mattresses, affecting bed aesthetics
Still retains some heat despite cooling gel, not ideal for hot sleepers
Slow memory foam response time may feel sluggish for active sleepers
verdict: The EGOHOME 8-inch memory foam mattress delivers solid comfort and support for most sleepers at a reasonable price point. While it has limitations like weak edge support and modest cooling, it excels at motion isolation and pressure relief where it matters most.
targetAudience: Side sleepers, couples needing motion isolation, budget-conscious buyers wanting memory foam comfort, and apartment dwellers who need compressed shipping options
